prompts.prompt: Give tonight's meal a restaurant name and introduce the menu in your most confident host voice.
Show one ingredient or item on your plate and tell the shortest story you associate with it.
Describe the first bite using three words that are not good, bad, tasty, or delicious.
Choose which part of your partner's meal you would sample first if you could reach across the table.
Share a childhood meal rule you followed, questioned, or quietly ignored.
Invent a playful award for something on each plate, such as best color, boldest texture, or most comforting smell.
Name a meal we have shared that you would happily repeat exactly as it happened.
Take a thirty-second quiet taste break, then compare the sound you noticed in each room.
Choose one food you changed your mind about and explain what caused the change.
Build an imaginary three-course menu for our next in-person celebration using both of tonight's meals as inspiration.
Tell the story of a cooking mistake that became funny, useful, or unexpectedly edible.
Pick one destination where you would like to share a simple local meal together.
Create a one-sentence advertisement for your current drink without naming it.
Choose a tiny table tradition we could repeat at future virtual dinners.
Share one non-food detail that made tonight feel more like a date than an ordinary call.
Offer a specific toast to something your partner handled well this week.
Plan the easiest possible menu for the next virtual dinner so neither person has to perform.
End by naming one moment from this meal you want your partner to remember tomorrow.
